summary.text: Angela McCarty is the Republican candidate for North Carolina State Senate District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Dan Blue (D).
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she described a background as a pilot, flight instructor and police officer.

paragraphs.text: Angela McCarty earned a bachelor's degree from Averett University in 1987, according to Ballotpedia, which lists her birthplace as Danville, Virginia.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in rural Virginia, studied business administration with an aviation specialization at Averett, and earned commercial and flight instructor pilot licenses.
She said she taught students at Averett, flew as a commercial pilot, worked as an undercover narcotics officer with a police department, and served as a pilot with the Virginia Defense Force.
She said she has lived in North Carolina for more than 32 years and became a minister in 2022.
McCarty was the Republican candidate for State Senate District 14 in 2024, when Dan Blue (D) defeated her in the general election.
She advanced to the 2026 general election after the March 3, 2026 Republican primary was canceled.
In the 2024 survey, she said her main focus was the safety of children in schools, supported school vouchers and school choice, and called for higher teacher pay.
